No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this study - they were only used as generation systems being evaluated.

guideline: Check if each element in input triples is verbalized (omission error)
Check if any content in verbalization does not correspond to input elements (addition error)
Check if any content is repeated without corresponding input repetition (repetition error)
